summary: Plan critical-service recovery, ransomware exercises, and continuity testing. Explore practical operational resilience training and enquire today.
lede: Training in digital resilience and cyber recovery planning helps continuity, IT and risk professionals prepare critical services for disruption. Participants map service dependencies, set recovery priorities, draft ransomware recovery actions, and design tabletop tests that capture findings. The syllabus also covers recovery objectives, restoration tracking, and reporting improvement priorities to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate continuity, cyber recovery, crisis decisions, and critical-service operations. It suits you if your role involves maintaining or testing recovery arrangements for digital processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business processes, IT services, cybersecurity, risk, or continuity planning will help you contribute to the exercises. You do not need programming skills; exercises use planning artefacts and Excel-based worksheets. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet access if you want to complete the digital tracking exercises directly.
